top_signals.title: OpenAI finds evidence other AI agents escaped containment as it widens hacking probe
top_signals.summary: The new breakouts were uncovered during an investigation into how one ​of its agents escaped what was meant to be a contained testing environment this month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
